functions.name: scaxis
functions.signature: void scaxis (float x1, float x2, int *nxnum, float *dxnum, float *fxnum);
functions.purpose: Choose readable numbered axis intervals and endpoints.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Uses log10, pow and sqrt with float-to-double conversions, integer truncation, and a rounding-adjustment loop.

functions.name: sgefa
functions.signature: void sgefa (float **a, int n, int *ipvt, int *info);
functions.purpose: Factor a general matrix using Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Single-precision elimination and pivot selection are sensitive to rounding and exact zero comparisons.

functions.name: sgeco
functions.signature: void sgeco (float **a, int n, int *ipvt, float *rcond, float *z);
functions.purpose: Factor a matrix and estimate its reciprocal condition number.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Condition estimation uses ordered single-precision reductions, rescaling, and branch-sensitive iterative solves.

functions.name: sgesl
functions.signature: void sgesl (float **a, int n, int *ipvt, float *b, int job);
functions.purpose: Solve a factored linear system or its transpose.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Preserve single-precision substitution and BLAS accumulation order, especially for ill-conditioned systems.

functions.name: shfs8r
functions.signature: void shfs8r (float dx, int nxin, float fxin, float yin[], float yinl, float yinr, int nxout, float fxout, float yout[]);
functions.purpose: Shift a uniformly sampled real signal using tabulated eight-point sinc interpolation.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Lazily builds a static coefficient table; shift rounding, extrapolation, and coefficient-major accumulation order affect results.

functions.name: fsinc
functions.signature: float fsinc (float x);
functions.purpose: Evaluate the normalized sinc function in single precision.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Uses sin and a special case at zero; intermediate precision and argument rounding matter.

functions.name: dsinc
functions.signature: double dsinc (double x);
functions.purpose: Evaluate the normalized sinc function in double precision.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Uses sin and a special case at zero; transcendental results vary slightly by platform.

functions.name: hpsort
functions.signature: void hpsort (int n, float a[]);
functions.purpose: Sort floating-point values in place using heapsort.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Comparison behavior for NaNs and equal values affects ordering.
functions.license_note: Heapsort is adapted from Standish; the file also references Numerical Recipes in C.

functions.name: qkisort
functions.signature: void qkisort (int n, float a[], int i[]);
functions.purpose: Sort indices by their associated floating-point values.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: A private partition routine uses a deterministic, persistent pseudo-random seed; comparisons and tie ordering matter.

functions.name: qkifind
functions.signature: void qkifind (int m, int n, float a[], int i[]);
functions.purpose: Partially sort indices to select the index at a requested rank.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: A private partition routine uses a deterministic, persistent pseudo-random seed; equal values and NaNs affect the resulting permutation.

functions.name: qksort
functions.signature: void qksort (int n, float a[]);
functions.purpose: Sort floating-point values in place using quicksort.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: A private partition routine uses a deterministic, persistent pseudo-random seed; float comparisons determine partition behavior.

functions.name: qkfind
functions.signature: void qkfind (int m, int n, float a[]);
functions.purpose: Partially sort values to place the requested order statistic.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: A private partition routine uses a deterministic, persistent pseudo-random seed; preserve partition and comparison behavior.

functions.name: sqrdc
functions.signature: void sqrdc (float **x, int n, int p, float *qraux, int *jpvt, float *work, int job);
functions.purpose: Compute a QR decomposition with optional column pivoting.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Householder transformations, norm updates, square roots, and pivot choices depend on single-precision rounding and reduction order.

functions.name: sqrsl
functions.signature: void sqrsl (float **x, int n, int k, float *qraux, float *y, float *qy, float *qty, float *b, float *rsd, float *xb, int job, int *info);
functions.purpose: Apply a QR decomposition to compute requested projections, coefficients, and residuals.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Preserve transformation order, single-precision dot products, exact zero checks, and supported output aliasing.

functions.name: sqrst
functions.signature: void sqrst (float **x, int n, int p, float *y, float tol, float *b, float *rsd, int *k, int *jpvt, float *qraux, float *work);
functions.purpose: Solve a possibly rank-deficient least-squares problem using pivoted QR.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Rank selection depends on a floating-point tolerance and QR diagonal values; output arrays are intentionally aliased in the solve.

functions.name: stoepd
functions.signature: void stoepd (int n, double r[], double g[], double f[], double a[]);
functions.purpose: Solve a symmetric Toeplitz system using double-precision recursion.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Preserve recursive update and accumulation order; near-singular systems amplify rounding.

functions.name: stoepf
functions.signature: void stoepf (int n, float r[], float g[], float f[], float a[]);
functions.purpose: Solve a symmetric Toeplitz system using single-precision recursion.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Preserve single-precision recursive update and accumulation order; near-singular systems amplify rounding.

functions.name: cwp_strdup
functions.signature: char * cwp_strdup(char *str);
functions.purpose: Allocate and return a duplicate of a C string.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point arithmetic; allocation failure and C string termination matter.

functions.name: strchop
functions.signature: void strchop(char *s, char *t);
functions.purpose: Copy a string while removing occurrences of a specified character.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point arithmetic; preserve byte and termination behavior.

functions.name: cwp_strrev
functions.signature: char * cwp_strrev (char *str);
functions.purpose: Allocate and return a byte-reversed copy of a C string.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point arithmetic; reversal operates on bytes rather than Unicode characters.

functions.name: svd_backsubstitute
functions.signature: void svd_backsubstitute(float **u, float w[], float **v, int m, int n, float b[], float x[]);
functions.purpose: Solve a linear system using a previously computed singular value decomposition.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Preserve single-precision dot-product accumulation and exact zero singular-value handling.
functions.license_note: File identifies compute_svd as adapted from Numerical Recipes through XLISP-STAT.

functions.name: compute_svd
functions.signature: int compute_svd(float **a, int m, int n, float *w, float **v);
functions.purpose: Compute a singular value decomposition of a real matrix.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Iterative bidiagonalization and QR convergence mix float storage with double intermediates and square roots; preserve iteration limits and operation order.
functions.license_note: Adapted from Numerical Recipes via XLISP-STAT 2.1; copyright 1989–1999 Luke Tierney, with adaptation attributed to Luke Tierney and David Betz.

functions.name: svd_sort
functions.signature: void svd_sort(float **u, float *w, float **v, int n, int m);
functions.purpose: Sort singular values and permute their corresponding singular vectors.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Comparison and tie behavior determine vector ordering.
functions.license_note: File identifies compute_svd as adapted from Numerical Recipes through XLISP-STAT.

functions.name: swap_short_2
functions.signature: void swap_short_2(short *tni2);
functions.purpose: Reverse the two bytes of a short in place.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Assumes a two-byte short and operates on its native representation.

functions.name: swap_u_short_2
functions.signature: void swap_u_short_2(unsigned short *tni2);
functions.purpose: Reverse the two bytes of an unsigned short in place.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Assumes a two-byte unsigned short and operates on its native representation.

functions.name: swap_int_4
functions.signature: void swap_int_4(int *tni4);
functions.purpose: Reverse four bytes of an int in place.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Assumes a four-byte int and operates on its native representation.

functions.name: swap_u_int_4
functions.signature: void swap_u_int_4(unsigned int *tni4);
functions.purpose: Reverse four bytes of an unsigned int in place.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Assumes a four-byte unsigned int and operates on its native representation.

functions.name: swap_long_4
functions.signature: void swap_long_4(long *tni4);
functions.purpose: Reverse the first four bytes of a long in place.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Long width is platform-dependent; on an eight-byte long only four bytes are swapped.

functions.name: swap_u_long_4
functions.signature: void swap_u_long_4(unsigned long *tni4);
functions.purpose: Reverse the first four bytes of an unsigned long in place.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Unsigned long width is platform-dependent; on an eight-byte long only four bytes are swapped.

functions.name: swap_float_4
functions.signature: void swap_float_4(float *tnf4);
functions.purpose: Reverse the four bytes of a float in place.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Operates on the native four-byte float representation, including NaN bit patterns.

functions.name: swap_double_8
functions.signature: void swap_double_8(double *tndd8);
functions.purpose: Reverse the eight bytes of a double in place.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Operates on native double bytes and assumes an eight-byte representation.

functions.name: eig_jacobi
functions.signature: void eig_jacobi(float **a, float d[], float **v, int n);
functions.purpose: Compute eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a symmetric matrix using Jacobi rotations.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Iterative rotations, thresholds, accumulated corrections, and square roots are sensitive to rounding and convergence order.

functions.name: sort_eigenvalues
functions.signature: void sort_eigenvalues(float d[], float **v, int n);
functions.purpose: Sort eigenvalues and rearrange their corresponding eigenvectors.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Comparison and tie behavior affect eigenvector ordering.

functions.name: temporary_stream
functions.signature: FILE *temporary_stream (char const * const prefix);
functions.purpose: Create an unlinked temporary file and return an open read-write stream.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point arithmetic; mkstemp naming, filesystem behavior, and stream creation are platform-dependent.

functions.name: temporary_filename
functions.signature: char *temporary_filename(char *prefix);
functions.purpose: Generate a temporary basename and prepend the supplied directory prefix.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point arithmetic; mkstemp naming and filesystem behavior are platform-dependent, and the implementation leaves its created file and descriptor open.

functions.name: tridif
functions.signature: void tridif (int n, float a[], float b[], float c[], float r[], float u[]);
functions.purpose: Solve a general tridiagonal system in single precision.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Forward elimination and back substitution are sequential; zero or small pivots are sensitive.

functions.name: tridid
functions.signature: void tridid (int n, double a[], double b[], double c[], double r[], double u[]);
functions.purpose: Solve a general tridiagonal system in double precision.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Forward elimination and back substitution are sequential; zero or small pivots are sensitive.

functions.name: tripd
functions.signature: void tripd(float *d, float *e, float *b, int n);
functions.purpose: Solve a symmetric positive-definite tridiagonal system in place.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Sequential single-precision factorization and substitution amplify rounding for ill-conditioned systems.

functions.name: tripp
functions.signature: void tripp(int n, float *d, float *e, float *c, float *b);
functions.purpose: Solve an unsymmetric tridiagonal system using the file's partial-pivoting algorithm.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Pivot comparisons and elimination order matter; its private exch helper takes arguments by value and therefore does not swap the caller's values.

functions.name: oppenheim_unwrap_phase
functions.signature: void oppenheim_unwrap_phase(int n, int trend, int zeromean, float df, float *xr, float *xi , float *phase);
functions.purpose: Unwrap phase by integrating a derivative calculated from the complex spectrum.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Differentiation, near-zero checks, integration order, and optional regression can amplify numerical error.
functions.license_note: Describes the Oppenheim and Schafer phase-unwrapping method and cites Digital Signal Processing (1975).

functions.name: simple_unwrap_phase
functions.signature: void simple_unwrap_phase(int n, int trend, int zeromean, float w, float *phase);
functions.purpose: Unwrap phase by detecting phase jumps and optionally removing a trend.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Threshold comparisons and sequential phase accumulation determine branch choices; optional regression adds rounding sensitivity.

functions.name: vanded
functions.signature: void vanded (int n, double v[], double b[], double x[]);
functions.purpose: Solve a Vandermonde system in double precision.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Sequential divided-difference-style updates depend on operation order and distinct nodes.

functions.name: vandef
functions.signature: void vandef (int n, float v[], float b[], float x[]);
functions.purpose: Solve a Vandermonde system in single precision.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Sequential single-precision updates depend on operation order and distinct nodes.

functions.name: ricker1_wavelet
functions.signature: void ricker1_wavelet (int nt, float dt, float fpeak, float *wavelet);
functions.purpose: Generate a sampled Ricker wavelet using the first formulation.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Uses exp and mixed floating-point constants; preserve sample timing and intermediate precision.

functions.name: ricker2_wavelet
functions.signature: void ricker2_wavelet (int hlw, float dt, float period, float ampl, float distort, float *wavelet);
functions.purpose: Generate a parameterized Ricker wavelet using the second formulation.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Uses exp and mixed floating-point constants; preserve indexing and sample timing.

functions.name: akb_wavelet
functions.signature: void akb_wavelet (int nt, float dt, float fpeak, float *wavelet);
functions.purpose: Generate an AKB wavelet.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Uses exp and mixed floating-point constants; preserve sample timing and rounding.

functions.name: spike_wavelet
functions.signature: void spike_wavelet (int nt, int tindex, float *wavelet);
functions.purpose: Generate a unit spike at the requested sample.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Writes exact zero and one values.

functions.name: unit_wavelet
functions.signature: void unit_wavelet (int nt, float *wavelet);
functions.purpose: Fill a waveform with ones.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Writes exact one values.

functions.name: zero_wavelet
functions.signature: void zero_wavelet (int nt, float *wavelet);
functions.purpose: Fill a waveform with zeros.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Writes exact zero values.

functions.name: berlage_wavelet
functions.signature:
void berlage_wavelet (int nt, float dt, float fpeak, float ampl, float tn, \
	float decay, float ipa, float *wavelet);
functions.purpose: Generate a parameterized Berlage wavelet.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Uses pow, exp, and cos with mixed precision; preserve time sampling and operation order.

functions.name: gaussian_wavelet
functions.signature: void gaussian_wavelet (int nt, float dt, float fpeak, float *wavelet);
functions.purpose: Generate a Gaussian wavelet.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Uses sqrt and exp with float and double intermediates.

functions.name: gaussderiv_wavelet
functions.signature: void gaussderiv_wavelet (int nt, float dt, float fpeak, float *wavelet);
functions.purpose: Generate a derivative-of-Gaussian wavelet.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Uses sqrt and exp with float and double intermediates.

functions.name: deriv_n_gauss
functions.signature: void deriv_n_gauss(double dt, int nt, double t0, float fpeak, int n, double *w, int sign, int verbose);
functions.purpose: Generate a normalized nth derivative of a Gaussian in double precision.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Uses exponential evaluation, Hermite recursion, float-to-double mixing, and maximum-based normalization; preserve the n=0 behavior.
functions.license_note: Copyright 2007 Society of Exploration Geophysicists; comment requires acceptance of usage terms at http://software.seg.org/disclaimer.txt.

functions.name: hanningnWindow
functions.signature: void hanningnWindow(int n,float *w);
functions.purpose: Generate an n-element Hanning window.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Uses cos and mixed floating-point constants; endpoint and small-n behavior follow the C expression.

functions.name: wrapArray
functions.signature: void wrapArray(void *base, size_t nmemb, size_t size, int f);
functions.purpose: Rotate an array by the requested number of elements.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Copies element bytes without floating-point arithmetic; signed shift and element-size handling matter.

functions.name: xcor
functions.signature: void xcor (int lx, int ifx, float *x, int ly, int ify, float *y, int lz, int ifz, float *z);
functions.purpose: Cross-correlate two real sequences over a requested output range.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Reverses one input and delegates accumulation to convolution; preserve index origins and convolution order.

functions.name: xindex
functions.signature: void xindex (int nx, float ax[], float x, int *index);
functions.purpose: Find the bracketing index in a monotonic array using a previous index as a search hint.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Float comparisons, duplicate values, and increasing versus decreasing array branches determine the returned index.

functions.name: yclip
functions.signature: int yclip (int nx, float dx, float fx, float y[], float ymin, float ymax, float xc[], float yc[]);
functions.purpose: Clip a piecewise-linear sampled function to a vertical range.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Sequential x increments, boundary comparisons, and interpolated crossing calculations affect the output vertices.

functions.name: yxtoxy
functions.signature: void yxtoxy (int nx, float dx, float fx, float y[], int ny, float dy, float fy, float xylo, float xyhi, float x[]);
functions.purpose: Invert a monotonic sampled function using linear interpolation.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Repeated float increments and inclusive interval comparisons affect interpolation and endpoint selection.

functions.name: zasc
functions.signature: int zasc(char *ainput, char *aoutput, integer nchar);
functions.purpose: Translate EBCDIC bytes to ASCII using a lookup table.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point arithmetic; signedness of char affects comparisons for bytes above 127, and unmatched bytes become spaces.
functions.license_note: Translated from Fortran by f2c; attributed to Stew Levin of Mobil.

functions.name: zebc
functions.signature: int zebc(char *ainput, char *aoutput, integer nchar);
functions.purpose: Translate ASCII bytes to EBCDIC using a lookup table.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point arithmetic; char signedness and byte representation are platform-dependent, and unmatched bytes become spaces.
functions.license_note: Translated from Fortran by f2c; attributed to Stew Levin of Mobil.
